```yaml
name: Prompt Test - Sentry Integration

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      environment:
        description: 'Environment to test against'
        required: true
        default: 'staging'
        type: choice
        options:
          - staging
          - production

jobs:
  test-sentry-integration:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: ${{ github.event.inputs.environment }}
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 9

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Configure Sentry Environment Variables
        run: |
          echo "SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN=${{ secrets.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "SENTRY_DSN=${{ secrets.SENTRY_DSN }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "SENTRY_ORG=${{ secrets.SENTRY_ORG }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "SENTRY_PROJECT=${{ secrets.SENTRY_PROJECT }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "SENTRY_ENVIRONMENT=${{ github.event.inputs.environment }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Build Trigger.dev Configuration
        run: pnpm build --filter=trigger.config
        
      - name: Run Sentry Source Map Upload
        uses: getsentry/action-release@v1
        env:
          SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN }}
          SENTRY_ORG: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_ORG }}
          SENTRY_PROJECT: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_PROJECT }}
        with:
          environment: ${{ github.event.inputs.environment }}
          sourcemaps: "./dist"
          ignore_missing: true
          ignore_empty: true

      - name: Verify Sentry Integration
        run: |
          echo "Verifying Sentry integration for ${{ github.event.inputs.environment }} environment"
          # Check if Sentry DSN is configured
          if [ -z "$SENTRY_DSN" ]; then
            echo "::error::SENTRY_DSN is not configured"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check if Sentry Auth Token is configured
          if [ -z "$SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN" ]; then
            echo "::error::SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN is not configured"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          echo "Sentry integration verification passed"

      - name: Post Test Result
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "## Sentry Integration Test Results" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- **Environment**: ${{ github.event.inputs.environment }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- **Status**: ${{ job.status }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- **Sentry DSN Configured**: ${{ env.SENTRY_DSN != '' }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- **Source Maps Uploaded**: ${{ steps.upload-sourcemaps.outcome == 'success' }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
```
